purpose: Curated free/paid certifications and course certificates relevant to Business / Analysis roles. Professional exam-based certifications are distinguished from course-completion certificates.
important_guidance: A course-completion certificate is not the same as a professional certification; keep credential_type visible when using this file.
Prices are in the issuer currency and may change; international tax, exchange rates, local pricing and promotions may apply.
Credentials are mapped to relevant roles as a shortlist, not a guarantee that employers require or prefer the credential.
For CV value, combine credentials with portfolio evidence such as a requirements document, process map, SQL analysis, dashboard, business case or product metrics case study.
Choose credentials based on target job descriptions rather than completing every option.
